crossRefs.note: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?

translations.web: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
translations.bsb: I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.
translations.kjv: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
